description: This file defines the GrainReferenceNotBoundException class, a custom exception used in the Orleans runtime to indicate that a GrainReference was not properly bound before use.

classes.name: GrainReferenceNotBoundException
classes.description: A sealed exception class indicating an unbound GrainReference in Orleans.

methods.name: CreateMessage
methods.description: Creates an error message indicating that a GrainReference was not constructed by the runtime.
